hooks.command: input=$(cat); tool=$(jq -r ".tool_name" <<<"$input"); billable=$(jq -r --arg t "$tool" "(.tool_input.command // \"\") as \$c | ((\$t==\"mcp__rikyu-hpc__submit_job\") or (\$t==\"mcp__plugin_rikyu_rikyu-hpc__submit_job\") or (\$t==\"Bash\" and (\$c | test(\"tests/smoke\\\\.py --job|sbatch|srun|salloc\"))))" <<<"$input"); if [ "$billable" = "true" ]; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"ask\",permissionDecisionReason:\"RIKYU compute is billed with no usage cap - confirm this job submission is intentional.\"}}"; fi
